name: Event Voting & Live Leaderboard by Clicksmith
author: Clicksmith Digital Marketing

sections.description:
• One vote per category per device (hashed device/ip/user-agent; no raw IP stored).
  • Live leaderboard shortcode with mobile layout and fullscreen.
  • Teams custom post type with booth numbers and category eligibility.
  • Winners view (admin + shortcode).
  • CSV export, voting lock, and reset for new events.
  • Auto-detects colors from Elementor/WP global variables with an optional accent override.
  • Optional “Powered by Clicksmith” branding bubble (off by default).
  • Extensible and translation-ready.

Plugin page: https://clicksmith.net/wordpress-plugins/clicksmith-event-voting

Shortcodes

[csvote_vote] — Render the vote form.

[csvote_live title=”Live Leaderboard” fullscreen_button=”true”] — Show the live board.

[csvote_winners title=”Winners” layout=”cards” show_votes=”true”] — Public winners view (toggle in Settings).

Privacy

This plugin stores salted hashes of device/ip/user-agent to prevent duplicate votes. No raw IP addresses are stored.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate.
  2. Go to Event Voting → Settings and set your categories (comma-separated).
  3. Add teams under Teams, assigning eligible categories and booth numbers.
  4. Create a page with [csvote_vote] and another with [csvote_live]. (Optional) Add [csvote_winners] if you want public winners.
